title: English Fell From 75% To 45% Of Web Pages
hook: English web pages fell to 45% as the world logged on.
closing: Using only English reveals just part of what the internet contains.
question: Which language do you browse?

segments.say: English held 75% of web pages. The early internet was far less multilingual.
Arabic content grew 2,501%. New users built the web in their own languages.
English still leads with 55% of websites. Nearly half now use other languages.
